titleEn: Inter-Ministerial Prakas No. 151 on the Establishment of the Revenue Budget for 2024 at the Ministry of Health

articles.en: A revenue budget is hereby established at the Ministry of Health in order to collect the following revenues: -73023 proceeds from the establishment of enterprises: 1,220,400,000 riels; -73024 proceeds from examination fees: 1,700,400,000 riels; -73087 proceeds from product quality inspection and compliance with standards: 8,670,000,000 riels; -74012 proceeds from fines and penalties: 340,800,000 riels.
The maximum amount authorised to be retained in the petty cash account shall not exceed 2,000,000 riels (two million riels).
Any decisions contrary to this inter-ministerial prakas shall be considered null and void.

The Secretary-General of the General Secretariat, the Director of the Cabinet, the Government Delegate in charge as Director-General of the General Department of the National Treasury, the Government Delegate in charge as Director-General of the General Department of State Property and Non-Tax Revenue, and the heads of the relevant units under the authority of the Ministry of Economy and Finance and the Ministry of Health shall be responsible for implementing this prakas from the date of signature onwards.
